classification.difficultyReason: Apply cosine rule and recognise an impossible triangle when its cosine lies outside the valid range.

content.prompt: Calculate the angle $\theta$ using cosine rule. Answer to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Black schematic triangle with horizontal base, apex above and right of the base midpoint, exterior sloping side labels and a lower-left interior angle arc.
spec.mathematics: Left side 6 cm, right side 4 cm, base 5 cm; theta between the 6 cm and 5 cm sides. Preserve source schematic proportions.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{1^2+1^2-5^2}{2(1)(1)}\\[8pt]\cos\theta&=-11.5\end{align*}$$
This is outside $[-1,1]$, so no such angle exists. Also, $1+1<5$, so the lengths cannot form a triangle.
